stem.text: A dimer, Q, is stable when solid but a dynamic equilibrium is set up in solution.
A solution of Q has an initial concentration of $0.50\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$. When equilibrium has been reached, $[\text{Q(aq)}]$ has fallen to $0.25\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$.
The changes in $[\text{Q(aq)}]$ and $[\text{R(aq)}]$ are plotted against time until equilibrium is reached. The value of $K_\text{c}$ is then calculated.
Which graph and value for $K_\text{c}$ are correct?
